shots.excerpt: Ground-level front wide, slow push-in: the glass facade behind her explodes in glittering shards and dust, the beast crashes through and lands behind her. She does not move.
shots.voice: Shot 2. A slow push-in while the glass tower explodes behind her. She doesn't even flinch.

shots.excerpt: Very low angle, tilted dutch frame: the beast reaches a giant clawed hand toward the lens; she dissolves into dark smoke with emerald-green particles, the claw closes on nothing.
shots.voice: Shot 3. A low dutch angle makes the beast huge. Then she melts into green smoke right under its claw.

shots.excerpt: Street-level side tracking shot: she sprints low, draws the katana and drops into a crouched lunge, the blade trailing glowing green and cyan energy.
shots.voice: Shot 4. A side tracking shot at street level, and the blade leaves a glowing ribbon of green energy.

shots.excerpt: Low angle, camera swinging upward: she flies high above the street and drives a mid-air flying side kick into the beast's jaw.
shots.voice: Shot 5. The camera swings up with her into a flying side kick straight to its jaw.

shots.excerpt: Low front wide: the beast rears up and slams both fists into the street; the asphalt cracks and a massive wall of dust swallows the frame.
shots.voice: Shot 7. Describing the cracking asphalt and the wall of dust is what gives every hit real weight.

shots.excerpt: Close-up, shallow depth of field: she holds the katana across her lower face, green smoke curling off the blade, staring straight into the lens.
shots.voice: Shot 10. A shallow focus close-up. The blade crosses her face and she stares right into the lens.
